label: Tracks belief S1 is good: positive at D2, negative at GO; raised at D2 after reward.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * prev_reward * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (1 - prev_reward)
terms: (phase == D2) * prev_reward ;; (phase == D2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * prev_reward ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 43 is pinned near -1 at D1 (no information), high at GO, moderate at D2. Beyond timing, it carries the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good with opposite sign by phase: at GO it is lower when S1 is believed good (a1 favoured), at D2 it is higher when S1 is believed good. At D2 it is also raised when the previous trial was rewarded (long runs of unrewarded trials drive it strongly negative). The free fit adds the D2 reached-state / this-choice terms (choosing a1 raises, reaching S1 lowers once belief is controlled) and a small GO prev-reward term; these lift dev R^2 from 0.48 to 0.56. Future variables, hidden good state and since-reversal are not needed.

issues: The free fit was under-searched. Adding D2 (1 - prev_reward), D2 action, GO prev_action and similar terms gets test R^2 beyond timing to 0.666, not 0.531. Against that, the recorded short form (0.444) keeps only about 67% of the free fit, below the 80% bar the verdict relied on.

Misses on the recorded short form show large systematic D2 errors. It over-predicts D2 after unrewarded trials: a2 S2 u by -0.333, a1 S1 u by -0.232, a1 S2 u by -0.224. It also over-predicts D2 after a1 S2 r (-0.246). Overall D2 mean error is -0.081 and GO mean error is +0.042. Under-predictions at GO after unrewarded trials (a2 S2 u +0.203, a1 S2 u +0.118) remain.

The D2 'tracks belief' claim is weak. Profile residuals at D2 split by previous trial: a1 S1 r +0.41 and a2 S1 r +0.195 (a reward in S1), while every unrewarded history is -0.25 to -0.38. Rewards in S2 are near 0 (about -0.07 to -0.10). That fits 'last reward came from S1' plus a penalty for no reward better than graded log-odds. Swapping D2 belief_lo for prev_reward*(prev_state==S1) together with a D2 (1 - prev_reward) term raises the score from 0.444 to 0.551 on test.

The GO belief_lo term holds up: its weight is negative (-0.037), and the GO residual falls steadily from belief decile 0 to 9 (+0.115 to -0.157). Replacing it with GO prev_action==1 gives 0.520, so it is roughly equivalent to 'previous choice was a1'.

The new form removes the per-phase bias (mean errors D1 0.000, GO +0.003, D2 -0.003). Residual errors are smaller but still present: D2 after a1 S2 u +0.21, D2 after a2 S1 r -0.18, GO after a1 S2 r -0.18, GO after a2 S2 u +0.16.
